ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) background with high-intensity (white) patches on distal lobes; approximately 30-40% white to 60-70% black ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, irregular high-contrast white blobs located on the outer-distal sections of both lobes. Left lobe contains a large triangular white patch; right lobe contains a similarly sized white patch interrupted by vertical dark lines. Medial fluke regions are solid black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations across the entire visible trailing edge, showing deep, irregular peaks and valleys isolated against the sky and water spray background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory for both lobes, tapering from the submerged center to sharp, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three to four distinct vertical dark linear markings (rake marks) cutting through the white pigmentation on the distal region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss and irregular deep notches along the trailing edge, specifically a deep indentation on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe.
